reason: Strider's response headers are one value per name, so a repeated header's values can't be read one by one as headersArray() gives them; Chromium reports them joined in one string, and no call returns the list

Strider loads and decodes a response's body before the response is delivered, so a body is never read after the page has navigated away from it. The original reads the body after the navigation and expects a readable error; Strider has no body read that a navigation can make fail, so the test has no Strider counterpart until a response body can be read after its delivery
